privacy.title: Privacy in WhatsDemo
privacy.description: How your journey is stored and shared.
privacy.storageBody: Your journey—including contact name, photo, messages, Flow JSON and automatic answers—and your interface language are stored locally using localStorage. They remain in this browser until you replace them or clear the saved data.
privacy.sharingBody: Copy Link encodes the full journey in the link, including uploaded images and Flow answers. Anyone with that link and access to the app can open its contents. Encoding and compression are not encryption. Include only information you intend to share.
privacy.deleteBody: Use your browser’s privacy or storage settings to clear this page’s saved data. This removes the local draft and language preference. Restoring the example replaces the journey; it does not clear all saved data. Downloaded files and previously copied links are not deleted.
privacy.connectionsBody: WhatsDemo does not set cookies or include advertising, analytics or trackers. The app does not upload journeys to a backend; generating a link and recording a video happen in your browser. When hosted online, the hosting provider may process access logs under its own privacy policy.
